summary: Antiphon nightly local readiness evaluator (CARD-0545 D-9). Desktop tag, every 30 minutes.
description: SSH-bridge wrapper that runs scripts/nightly-health.ps1 on the Windows host. It evaluates the local nightly state, the Windmill registration and the independent watchdog's snapshot, then writes C:\Antiphon\nightly\last-monitor.json for the server's readiness reader. It is not the independent monitor and sends no notification. Expected hashes, the watchdog snapshot URL and instance id come from C:\Antiphon\nightly\readiness-config.json (written at qualification); WINDMILL_TOKEN_FILE names an operator-placed token file. No watchdog host is named here.
content:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
ssh -i /tmp/windmill/worker_to_windows -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes lndco@host.docker.internal 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\src\Antiphon\scripts\nightly-health.ps1 -RepositoryPath C:\src\Antiphon -ReadinessConfigPath C:\Antiphon\nightly\readiness-config.json'
exit $?
